biocontainers.name: bioconductor-lefser
biocontainers.summary: R implementation of the lefse method for microbiome biomarker discovery

biotools.summary: lefser is the R implementation of the popular microbiome biomarker discovery too, LEfSe. It uses the Kruskal-Wallis test, Wilcoxon-Rank Sum test, and Linear Discriminant Analysis to find biomarkers from two-level classes (and optional sub-classes).
